title: Outdoor Storytime
tips:
Weekly · Sundays in front of the store — guest authors sometimes fill this slot; check the Linden Tree calendar.
Manresa Bread next door if you want a treat.
description: Join us every Sunday morning at 10:30am in front of the store as one of our booksellers (or perhaps a local author) shares some of their favorite read-alouds. All storytimes feature picture books and are appropriate for all ages.
